foot-built-pre: Commons Data Weaver, built and maintained by
loginbar-text: You are not logged in. You can load files and prepare edits now; log in before you save.
login-required-text: Saving edits needs your Wikimedia account. Log in with Wikimedia (OAuth) and Data Weaver will edit as you.
login-required-note: The login opens in a new tab, so the files and edits in this tab stay where they are.
settings-language-help: Applies to menus and dialogs now; the rest of the tool is translated step by step.
settings-typing-enable: Use input methods in text fields
settings-typing-help: Your system keyboard is used by default. Press Ctrl+M in any text field to switch to this typing tool, and Ctrl+M again to go back. (Input methods from jQuery IME, the same as Wikipedia's Universal Language Selector.)
settings-typing-try: Click here, press Ctrl+M, and try your input method
settings-typing-ready: $1 languages available. In any text field, press Ctrl+M to switch between your system keyboard and the chosen method.
settings-osm-help: Off by default. When on, the place names you type are sent to nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which is not run by Wikimedia. Wikidata place search always works.
settings-local-note: Settings are stored in this browser only.
typing-on: Typing tool on: $1. Press Ctrl+M for the system keyboard.
typing-off: System keyboard. Press Ctrl+M for your typing tool.
typing-not-set: No typing tool is set up. Open the gear ⚙, tick the typing option and choose a language and method.
